name: RotatingText-TS-TW
title: Rotating Text
description: A fixed sentence keeps one slot open for a changing word: each phrase slides up from below as the last slides out. The swapping word sits in bright blue against the white rest.
use: A headline should name several qualities, audiences or verbs in the same slot.
avoid: Screens that need constant reading: the keyword vanishes during each swap, as frames 3 and 5 show.
a11y: The current word is mirrored for screen readers, but swaps ignore reduced-motion and there are no visible controls. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A short sentence in bold white type sits centred on black, with one word picked out in bright blue. The line is compact and tightly spaced.
behaves: Every couple of seconds the blue word drops away and the next rises from below the baseline, leaving a short gap in the middle of the sentence. The words on either side never move.
customise: The phrase list, interval, split mode, stagger, spring transition, loop and autoplay are props; colours and spacing come from class overrides.
weight: light: A few animated character spans swapped on a timer.
